spoken_first_2s: अरे गुड्डू भाई हां गाड़ी पे हेलीकॉप्टर

notes.hook: 'Guddu bhai, gaadi pe helicopter sign jalta hai, gaadi ud to nahi jayegi?' flipped into 'ignore kiya to bahut paise uda degi'
notes.what_goes_wrong: After the joke, seconds 13-30 are a sensor lecture; one real symptom and one real repair bill would keep the money stake alive.
notes.reusable_pattern: Open with the dumb question a beginner is scared to ask, flip it into a money stake ('ignore kiya to paise udayegi'), then teach one thing as Day N of a series.
